scenario.goal_zh: 选定沙漠旅行主题并区分长期气候与每日记录。

context_zh: 学生为地理课创作虚构旅行日记，教师帮助她缩小题材并区分气候资料与日常叙述。
author: author-phase03-b

sentences.speaker: Student Freya
sentences.text: Can I write my geography diary about an imaginary journey?

sentences.speaker: Teacher Ade
sentences.text: Yes, as long as you make that clear. Which continent will you choose?

sentences.speaker: Student Freya
sentences.text: Africa. I would like to set the journey in a desert.

sentences.speaker: Teacher Ade
sentences.text: That is still a large topic. Choose one place, then research its climate.

sentences.speaker: Student Freya
sentences.text: Should I put the climate information into every entry?

sentences.speaker: Teacher Ade
sentences.text: No. Use a short introduction for the usual conditions. The diary entries can describe your invented day-to-day journey.

sentences.speaker: Student Freya
sentences.text: All right. I will choose the location first and bring you a plan tomorrow.
